name: Clerk
description: Standalone Clerk integration: clerkMiddleware route protection, server-side auth helpers, org/app-level RoleGuard component, protected route group, and a JWT-template API example

questions.prompt: JWT template name for API auth?

checklist: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY and CLERK_SECRET_KEY from the Clerk dashboard
Add <SignIn /> and <SignUp /> pages at the configured sign-in/sign-up URLs (Clerk hosts the UI)
If using org/role features: enable Organizations in the Clerk dashboard; RoleGuard org=true gates on orgRole
For app-level roles: set sessionClaims.metadata.role via a custom session token claim
Create the JWT template in the Clerk dashboard (name must match your 'JWT template name for API auth?' answer) if the API example mints downstream tokens
Standalone framework — conflicts with all Group A adapters and the other Group B frameworks; use only one auth strategy
Test flow: visit a protected path while signed out → redirected to /sign-in; GET /api/protected-example returns 401 without a session
